g.text: FINITE / ILLUSTRATIVE: exact-formula evaluations at different marked basepoints; not a sharp flow-map modulus or arbitrary fixed-background instability.

g.text: The action interval is inherited from sealed R0.73M analysis. Arbitrary fixed-background instability, full 3D FPS H3-L2, singularity, and Clay claims remain open.
